scopes.name: build.artifact
scopes.description: A build output such as an APK, AAB, or AAR.

scopes.name: jvm.process
scopes.description: One Gradle-related JVM process or an aggregation over those processes.

scopes.name: jvm.gc
scopes.description: Garbage-collection observations parsed from one JVM GC log.

metrics.name: jvm.process.memory.heap.used
metrics.description: Heap used at the observation point.

metrics.name: jvm.process.memory.heap.committed
metrics.description: Heap capacity committed at the observation point.

metrics.name: jvm.process.memory.heap.peak
metrics.description: Peak heap usage during the observed lifetime.

metrics.name: jvm.process.memory.metaspace.peak
metrics.description: Peak metaspace usage during the observed lifetime.

metrics.name: jvm.process.cpu.time
metrics.description: CPU time consumed by the JVM process.

metrics.name: jvm.process.cpu.cores
metrics.description: Average CPU time divided by uptime; values may exceed one.

metrics.name: jvm.process.gc.time
metrics.description: Cumulative time spent in garbage collection.

metrics.name: jvm.process.classes.loaded
metrics.description: Loaded-class count at the observation point.

metrics.name: jvm.gc.events
metrics.description: GC log events grouped by action/description.

metrics.name: jvm.gc.event.time
metrics.description: Distribution of GC event timestamps since JVM start.

attributes.name: build.tool.name
attributes.description: Build tool that produced the report.

attributes.name: process.pid
attributes.description: Operating-system process identifier. Never encode this in a metric or custom-value name.

attributes.name: jvm.process.role
attributes.description: Role of the JVM in the build.

attributes.name: jvm.gc.name
attributes.description: Normalized garbage collector name, for example G1 or ZGC.

attributes.name: jvm.gc.action
attributes.description: GC event description parsed from the log.

attributes.name: gradle.project.path
attributes.description: Gradle project path that produced an artifact.

attributes.name: log.file.name
attributes.description: GC log base file name; never include an absolute path.
